apps.name: Masterpiece MUSE iPhone
apps.notes: Internet room fixes: 5 s heartbeat keeps the relay room alive (joiner no longer gets 'can't find a room'), snapshots shrunk under the relay's 1024-byte frame limit (4-player start was 1109 B), 'Stop internet' no longer force-closes (stop runs off the UI thread), room-lost state + live indicator, joiner retry + 15 s timeout, per-cause connection messages. Internet multiplayer via relay room codes (4-letter code, addressed delivery — snapshots stay private); LAN WiFi play unchanged. English fixes (E1-E13) + layout fixes (L1-L6); The Bedroom is the correct AIC 1889 version (F484, File:1926.417); New Game on the title screen with save/resume.
